question: In a certain code language, if TEA is coded as RFY, COFFEE is coded as APDGCF, then what will SUGAR be coded as?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/914456ecd02a295fcb6a97049dfda1145c674dab9f03e8a7de5db8403c4b7657.png] 

The logic followed here is,

**TEA: RFY**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/673e5038e29ec327ef7bae50262323fbc72c3d156b668f2f5613e653c5a0a3fc.png] 

**COFFEE: APDGCF**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fefe994ce72b1497368e17b7fcd78c9eab9a0116547dbbf2d7df839c6c6c859e.png] 

Similarly,

**SUGAR: ?**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5bd499e729e79d6c632796d7f9832952d70cf96f3f6664ebadc7715032faacda.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"****QVEBP"**.
